verdict.rationale: Cline ships a first-party CLI. It installs via npm, supports interactive terminal sessions and headless automation with processable output, takes piped input, has auto-approve flags, and can run cron-scheduled agents. The probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI itself (the community comments discuss the editor agent, not the CLI).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use Cline CLI for interactive terminal sessions and automated headless workflows.
Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
